fields.title: Anonymize Correctly
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: An analyst requests an export: order date, district, product categories, amount, age group. What is dangerous here and how to fix it?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: the combination of date, district, and age group can uniquely identify a person, especially in a sparsely populated district. Fixes: round the date to the week, district to the city or generalized zone, apply group threshold — do not show rows where the feature combination occurs in fewer than 10 people. Check categories for sensitive ones — baby food, gluten-free — and exclude or generalize them. Takeaway: removing the name does not constitute anonymization.
